name: xprs_loracrypto
description: The curve and cipher primitives the LoRa networks share: X25519 (RFC 7748), Ed25519 (RFC 8032), HMAC-SHA256, and a callsign's derived seed. Platform-independent; the target supplies xlc_aes_encrypt_block() and xlc_sha512() (xlc_aes_idf.c and xlc_sha512_idf.c on ESP-IDF, xlc_sha512_sw.c elsewhere).
